result.instructions: Tools for Briox, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my customer invoices are overdue, and how much is open in total?"; "List my supplier invoices from this month."; "Show the voucher entries of the last financial year for account 1930.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Briox data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run briox_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run briox_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run briox_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. briox_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: briox_get_company_info
tools.title: Get the company information
tools.description: The Briox company the connection belongs to: name, address, bank details, organization number and more. Good first call. GET /company/info.

tools.name: briox_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (custno, name, address, e-mail, phone, company number, active flag). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /customer.

company_number.description: Only the customer with this company (organization) number.

modified_since.description: Only objects modified after this moment: yyyy-mm-dd or 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM'.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (supplierno, name, address, e-mail, company number). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /supplier.

company_number.description: Only the supplier with this company (organization) number.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_list_customer_invoices
tools.title: List customer invoices
tools.description: List customer (sales) invoices with total, saldo (open amount), invoice and due date, customer. Filter by date range, status (for example overdue, unsettled, finalpayed) and type. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /customerinvoice.

from_date.description: Invoices dated on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Invoices dated on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

modified_since.description: Only objects modified after this moment: yyyy-mm-dd or 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM'.

status.description: Status filter (default all): unsettled = not fully paid, overdue = past due date, finalpayed = fully paid.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_list_supplier_invoices
tools.title: List supplier invoices
tools.description: List supplier (purchase) invoices with total, saldo, payment status, invoice and payment date, supplier. Filter by date range. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /supplierinvoice.

from_date.description: Invoices dated on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Invoices dated on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

modified_since.description: Only objects modified after this moment: yyyy-mm-dd or 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM'.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_list_items
tools.title: List items (articles)
tools.description: List items (products and services) with description, unit, type, prices, VAT rate and stock. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /item.

supplier_item_number.description: Only items with this supplier item number.

manufacturer_item_number.description: Only items with this manufacturer item number.

modified_since.description: Only objects modified after this moment: yyyy-mm-dd or 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM'.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: One customer with addresses, payment terms, VAT number, delivery methods and defaults. GET /customer/{id}.

customer_id.description: The customer id (the customer number, custno, from briox_list_customers).

tools.name: briox_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: One supplier with addresses, bank details, payment terms and defaults. GET /supplier/{id}.

tools.name: briox_get_customer_invoice
tools.title: Get a customer invoice
tools.description: One customer invoice with rows, totals, saldo, payment and reminder state. GET /customerinvoice/{id}.

invoice_id.description: The customer invoice id (id from briox_list_customer_invoices).

tools.name: briox_get_supplier_invoice
tools.title: Get a supplier invoice
tools.description: One supplier invoice with rows, totals, payment status, linked files and deviations. GET /supplierinvoice/{id}.

invoice_id.description: The supplier invoice id (id from briox_list_supplier_invoices).

tools.name: briox_get_item
tools.title: Get an item (article)
tools.description: One item (article) with prices, VAT rate, accounts, stock and supplier data. GET /item/{id}.

tools.name: briox_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts (chart of accounts)
tools.description: List ledger accounts with description, VAT code, active flag and incoming balance for a financial year. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /account.

year.description: The financial year id from briox_list_financial_years.

active.description: true = only active accounts, false = only inactive.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_list_financial_years
tools.title: List financial years
tools.description: List the financial years (id, from and to date, accounting method). The id is the financial year argument of the journal tools. GET /financialyear.

tools.name: briox_list_journal_series
tools.title: List journal (voucher) series
tools.description: List the journal series of a financial year (for example A, B). GET /journal/series/{financialyear}.

financial_year.description: The financial year id from briox_list_financial_years.

tools.name: briox_list_journals
tools.title: List journals (vouchers)
tools.description: List journal entries (vouchers with their debit/credit rows) of a financial year, optionally of one series and a date range. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /journal/{financialyear}[/{series}].

financial_year.description: The financial year id from briox_list_financial_years.

from_date.description: Entries on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Entries on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_get_journal
tools.title: Get a journal (voucher)
tools.description: One journal entry with all its debit/credit rows. GET /journal/{financialyear}/{series}/{id}.

financial_year.description: The financial year id from briox_list_financial_years.

tools.name: briox_get_bank_account_balances
tools.title: Get bank account balances
tools.description: The balances of the company's bank accounts. GET /bank/accountbalance.

tools.name: briox_list_vat_codes
tools.title: List VAT codes
tools.description: List VAT codes with description and percentage. GET /vatcode.

tools.name: briox_list_payment_terms
tools.title: List payment terms
tools.description: List payment terms (the ids usable on customers and invoices). GET /payment/term.

tools.name: briox_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects with leader, status, dates and customers. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /project.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_list_cost_centers
tools.title: List cost centers
tools.description: List cost centers (code, text, active). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /costcenter.

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_list_sales_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders, optionally by date range and status. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /salesorder.

from_date.description: Orders dated on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Orders dated on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number (the first page is 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: briox_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer in Briox (the customer number custno is assigned by you; use a free number). Creates a new record; it never changes an existing one. POST /customer.

vat_number.description: VAT number starting with the 2-letter country code.

tools.name: briox_create_item
tools.title: Create an item (article)
tools.description: Create an item (a product or service) in Briox. Prices are set in Briox afterwards. Creates a new record only. POST /item.

item_id.description: Item number; Briox picks the next free one when omitted.

unit.description: Unit, for example st, h, each.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, for example 25.

tools.name: briox_create_customer_invoice
tools.title: Create an unposted customer invoice
tools.description: Create a customer invoice that is NOT posted (post=false): it is saved for review and the user posts and sends it in Briox. Needs an existing customer and at least one row. POST /customerinvoice.
